result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane arterial road with commercial land use. While marked crosswalks and traffic signals are present, the long crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large vehicles like the bus can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light, making them more visible in the crosswalk.

result.summary: The intersection is characterized by a very wide roadway with multiple lanes and no visible pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or dedicated signals. This creates a hostile environment for pedestrians due to long exposure times and high-speed vehicle traffic typical of such expansive road geometries.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, significantly increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no visible painted markings to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to potential crossing locations at this large intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and push buttons to provide clear crossing intervals.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the long crossing distance and car-centric design create significant exposure for pedestrians crossing this arterial road.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: High-Speed Road Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt surface near the crossing area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane or shoulder to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being signalized for vehicles. A large food truck parked near the corner creates a significant visual obstruction, further increasing risk for anyone attempting to cross the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings are visible to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing locations at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: The large food truck parked near the intersection corner blocks sightlines between pedestrians and approaching traffic.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Intersection daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection corners to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
